items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I was the first one to bring Coltrane to New York... when he got with Miles he started coming out of wherever he had been hiding... But Trane was an amazing guy. I mean, as soon as he got with Miles' group, he changed altogether.

ctx.x: Well, I remember Miles, he always used to put them down, and then when I went to his apartment, he had them all over the wall!
Yeah! Heh-heh, that's where they go. Let's see, I think Miles came on the scene... He started getting into it in '47 -- or '48, I guess it was. He came in third, fourth, third, second, then first.
So how did Paris and Europe hit you after having been living here all your life, and...?
